nodes.label: Awesomic Editorial Style (inspiration)
nodes.rationale: Calm zinc palette, strong hierarchy, rounded surfaces and orange accent, adapted for a desktop document-processing app where information and actions are easy to find.

nodes.label: Home Page Structure (intro, 3-step guide, four tools)
nodes.norm_label: home page structure (intro, 3-step guide, four tools)

nodes.label: Inline Results (Open Excel/CSV, Copy Log)
nodes.rationale: Changing the folder invalidates old result links and preview state.

nodes.label: JSON-per-Line Engine Protocol
nodes.rationale: Engine streams log, progress and results as one JSON object per line; runner contract covers event order, crashes, large stderr and stray output.

nodes.label: Electron Main Process (app/main.js)
nodes.rationale: Owns windows, native dialogs, IPC validation, job state and updates.

nodes.label: MODULES Tool Metadata (app/main.js)
nodes.rationale: Metadata for the four tools is defined once in MODULES in the main process.

nodes.label: npm test Suite (engine.test.js, app.test.js, update.test.js)
nodes.rationale: Runner contract tests plus Electron E2E (navigation, responsive layout without overflow, keyboard, four tools, confirmation, locking, renderer isolation, single instance). EXPCORE_SCALE runs at 125%/150%; EXPCORE_APP targets the packaged app and adds update-flow tests against a local server.

nodes.label: Python Engine (expcore_engine.py -> ExpCore.py)
nodes.rationale: PDF parser and Excel/CSV export, one process per job; extraction logic in ExpCore.py is independent of the UI.

nodes.label: Automatic Updates
nodes.rationale: Checks latest stable release after the window opens; download and install only with user consent; download verified with SHA-512 from latest.yml; install is held while a PDF job runs; network errors during auto-check are silent so the app works offline.

nodes.label: build_release.py Build Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Nuitka bundles from the interpreter that runs it and only warns on missing modules, producing a broken exe; so the pipeline compiles the engine, smoke-tests it on synthetic PDFs for all four tools (stopping on missing modules), then runs electron-builder. --app-only skips the slow engine rebuild.

nodes.label: Bukti Potong 2024 Module
nodes.rationale: Reads pre-Coretax BPBS forms; outputs !Hasil_Rekap_Bupot_2024.xlsx. Tarif accepted as integer or decimal (2, 2.00, 2,00). Sifat read from the X checkbox on H.4/H.5 and set to '-' instead of guessing when not exactly one box is checked.

nodes.label: Bukti Potong 2026 Module
nodes.rationale: Reads BPPU Coretax forms; outputs !Hasil_Rekap_Bupot.xlsx. Separate parser from the 2024 module; the two do not substitute each other.

nodes.label: Per-Machine NSIS Installer
nodes.rationale: Installs to C:\Program Files\ExpCore (admin). Does not auto-uninstall 2.x: users must uninstall 2.x first or get duplicate entries and possible breakage of 3.x. Executable is unsigned, so SmartScreen may warn.

nodes.label: Pajak Masukan Module
nodes.rationale: Extracts buyer, invoice number, items, DPP, PPN and net; outputs Hasil_Pajak_Masukan.xlsx. PPN computed with a fixed 12% rate.

nodes.label: 151 PDF Samples Regression (--pdf-samples)
nodes.rationale: Re-checks 151 local feedback PDFs in contoh-pdf/JAN and FEB without modifying them: JAN must yield 75 rows and FEB 76, including nine files previously missed because tarif was written as an integer.

nodes.label: Automatic Bupot PDF Renaming
nodes.rationale: Name pattern: Nama Pemotong (C.3) - Nomor Bukti - Masa Pajak - Sifat - Status.pdf. If C.3 is empty the PDF is skipped rather than falling back to the recipient name. Existing names are never overwritten; a suffix like (2) is added. Each preview/apply run writes an audit CSV log.

nodes.label: Release Publishing Process
nodes.rationale: Bump version, run all tests, build, test packaged app, create a draft GitHub release tagged v+version, upload installer, blockmap and latest.yml (without latest.yml no update is offered), then publish as latest.

nodes.label: Electron Migration Verification (8 Oct 2026)
nodes.rationale: Parser unchanged: v2.0.1 and new code on 151 real BPBS PDFs plus synthetic PDFs gave identical Excel, CSV logs, rename results and log messages in 12/12 comparisons, repeated three times. Tests pass at 100/125/150% scale in dev (25/25) and packaged/installed (29 pass + 1 skipped). Installer tested on real Windows 11. Intermittent E2E failures only seen when the desktop is in use; artefacts saved to %TEMP%\expcore-e2e-artefak.

nodes.label: Container-Query Responsive Layout
nodes.rationale: Container queries on page width: home title 34px below 840px, guide becomes compact row below 690px, cards single column below 600px. Content scrolls in short windows while the processing button stays fixed at the bottom. Minimum window 960x620 logical px; initial size adapts to screen and DPI.

nodes.label: Folder Field and Picker Control
nodes.rationale: 44px height, 14px radius, 2px border so focus color change never resizes the control. Quoted paths pasted from Explorer 'Copy as path' are accepted. Hint text explains the format for the active tool.

nodes.label: Independently Scrolling Activity Log
nodes.rationale: Long logs scroll independently and fill remaining activity-card height (min 130px); at the log end native scroll chaining forwards the wheel to the page. A bug where the auto-scrolled log swallowed one wheel tick at 150% DPI was fixed and covered by a test.

nodes.label: Job Locking During Processing
nodes.rationale: Folder and processing controls are locked while one job runs to prevent stacked jobs; navigation stays active. The Electron main process is the source of truth for job state; engine progress and logs reach the renderer via IPC.

nodes.label: Native Confirmation Dialogs (Batal default)
nodes.rationale: Replacing an existing recap requires confirmation; buttons are named by action with Batal (Cancel) as default. Closing the app or installing an update while a job runs is held until results and logs are written.

nodes.label: Persistent Sidebar with Per-Tool Session State
nodes.rationale: Each tool keeps its own folder, activity and results for the session; folder paths can be typed or picked through a native dialog.
nodes.norm_label: persistent sidebar with per-tool session state

nodes.label: Preview-Before-Apply Renaming Rule
nodes.rationale: Apply button enabled only after a completed preview; the main process also rejects apply for folders without a preview (defense in depth). Confirmation explains that apply rescans the current folder state.

nodes.label: Skip-and-Log Unreadable PDFs
nodes.rationale: A PDF that fails to read is logged and skipped so the rest of the batch still processes.

nodes.label: Visual Tokens (zinc palette, #ff5a00 accent, Segoe UI)
nodes.rationale: Colors defined once as CSS variables in app/renderer/styles.css. Segoe UI is native on Windows, so no font download and it works offline. Cards use thin borders without drop shadow. Status uses text so color is never the only differentiator; orange badges use dark text for small-text contrast.
nodes.norm_label: visual tokens (zinc palette, #ff5a00 accent, segoe ui)

nodes.label: Explicit .venv Interpreter and Forward-Slash Rule
nodes.rationale: Bare 'python' follows PATH and may resolve to another interpreter even with a venv 'activated'. Forward slashes work in both PowerShell and Git Bash; backslashes are escape characters in Git Bash. Dev mode runs the engine via ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe.

nodes.label: Local-Only Processing (privacy)
nodes.rationale: ExpCore never sends PDFs or extraction results to the internet; update checks only read public release metadata over HTTPS and the app holds no GitHub token.

nodes.label: package.json Version as Single Source
nodes.rationale: version in package.json is the only source for app version, executable metadata and installer, in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format.

nodes.label: Disclaimer of Warranty and Limitation of Liability (Sections 7-8)
nodes.rationale: Work is provided AS IS with no warranties and no contributor liability, which is what makes an unpaid tax-document parser distributable at all.
nodes.norm_label: disclaimer of warranty and limitation of liability (sections 7-8)

nodes.label: Grant of Patent License (Section 3)
nodes.rationale: Patent grant terminates if the licensee files patent litigation over the Work, a defensive-termination trade-off in exchange for the irrevocable royalty-free grant.

nodes.label: Redistribution Conditions (Section 4)
nodes.rationale: Redistribution requires shipping the license, marking modified files, retaining attribution notices, and propagating any NOTICE file.

nodes.label: Non-standard appendix note about Eclipse Public License
nodes.rationale: The appendix contains a sentence not present in the canonical Apache 2.0 text, advising also obtaining an 'Eclipse Public License' if hosting the code. Provenance and intent unclear; flagged for review.
nodes.norm_label: non-standard appendix note about eclipse public license

nodes.label: Preload Bridge (window.expcore API)
nodes.rationale: app/preload.js is the only bridge between renderer and main, limiting renderer surface.

nodes.label: Sandboxed Renderer (app/renderer, contextIsolation)
nodes.rationale: Framework-less HTML/CSS/JS with no Node access (sandbox, contextIsolation).

nodes.label: Strict CSP and Navigation Lockdown
nodes.rationale: Renderer loads only local files under a strict Content-Security-Policy; navigation, new windows, webview and device permissions are denied; default menu and DevTools are unavailable in the installed app.
